description: Write the cable specification for a tender, one cable or a project, each as design_cable takes it, with the project's requirements: the specification in tender order (Markdown and text) and the required / offered schedule (CSV and JSON), REQUIRED filled with sources, OFFERED left for the bidder. Deterministic, no LLM; a draft to check. Notes: thecablecode://guide/write_specification. Always paid: $2.00 for the first cable, $0.50 for each further cable in the same call, up to 30, USDC (x402).

cables.description: Or a project: cables, each {sentence | spec | design, installation, fault_s, drum}.

drum.description: The drums section's line; absent: the bidder proposes.

fault_s.description: Fault duration for the short-circuit rows, s (default 1).

installation.description: For the current rating row, as design_cable takes it.

lang.description: Language of the specification; default en.

requirements.description: Requirement ids (rodent, uv-sunlight, flame-bunched, fire-resistance, longitudinal-watertight ...), or {id, option}; set on every cable. Every id and option: thecablecode://guide/write_specification or GET /api/v1/spec/requirements.

sentence.description: One cable, as design_cable takes it.

name: write_specification
title: Write a cable specification and its required / offered schedule
